open_points.subject: Run start refusal reason when flow is missing
open_points.text: A16 rule 1: "A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks"; A12 rule 1: "the kernel checks ... the flow exists and has an active version"
open_points.question: If `run` is requested for a non-existent flow, must the refusal always be `unknown reference`, or may it be the run-start condition "no active version"?
options: Always return `unknown reference` for missing flow ids (A16 precedence)
Treat "flow exists and has an active version" as one combined run-start check and return a run-start refusal
open_points.default_guess: Always return `unknown reference` for a missing flow id, then use "no active version" only for existing flows.

open_points.subject: Binding re-check before send (A08 rule 6)
open_points.text: A08 rule 6: "fails one of rule 5's checks of the record itself — not those of the instance, which are A09 rule 6's own"
open_points.question: Exactly which A08 rule-5 checks are considered "record itself" vs "instance" for deciding `binding_stale` versus A09 pre-send `operation_failed` details?
options: Only service file + capability-entry checks are "record itself"; all instance-derived facts (api_base_url, required_headers, instance class) are "instance"
Treat some mixed checks (e.g., duplicate required headers) as record checks and map them to `binding_stale`
open_points.default_guess: Classify only service/capability-entry validity and digest mismatch as `binding_stale`; classify instance/address/header-class constraints under A09 pre-send details.

open_points.subject: Path placeholder grammar and reuse in service invocation
open_points.text: A09 rule 2: "every `{name}` in the path takes the input port of that name"
open_points.question: What is the exact placeholder grammar (escaping/literals) and are repeated placeholders in one path allowed or refused?
options: Simple literal `{name}` tokens, repeated names allowed and substituted each time
Require each placeholder name to appear at most once; duplicates refused at proposal time
Define escaping for literal braces and reject ambiguous patterns
open_points.default_guess: Use simple `{name}` token parsing, allow repeated placeholders, and substitute the same validated input value each occurrence.
